propositions: One global deployed-sha state shared between review-bot and mcp blue-green components causes early exits to lose completion records and redeploy components unnecessarily on the next tick
A single deploy-backoff gate triggered from both bot and mcp blocks causes cross-component throttling where an mcp failure suppresses bot deployment and vice versa
Components skipped by open backoff windows lack incompleteness markers, causing the footer to incorrectly record them as deployed and permanently drop pending changes on subsequent ticks

Per-component completion markers (mcp-deployed-sha, bot-deployed-sha) must be written when each component completes and re-point component delta gates to compare against their own markers rather than the global baseline
Separate backoff recorders must allow each component's throttle gate to skip only that component and preserve the AUTODEPLOY_ERROR marker for observability.sh metric collection
